Explicit two-row Fourier minor gives rank two in the only exceptional fourfold level and rank two in all ordinary doublets. Dissipative finite-dimensional spectral decomposition identifies surviving modes exactly. The Gram inverse proves site probabilities with strictly positive denominator. Checker independently matches 68,328 site values and six long-time dynamical examples; finite checks are corroboration, not the all-prime proof.

value.rationale: Adding a positive next-neighbor interaction to prime cycles defeats the robust two-site observability of the nearest-neighbor model at a completely enumerated finite set of isolated ratios, creating exactly two dissipation-free modes. The rank-2/p survival jump, independence from trap separation and rates, and exact local survival profile are interpretable quantitative transport benchmarks, not arbitrary parameter enumeration. The prime restriction is required for the cyclotomic isolation of crossings and full-rank observation; the result resolves a natural structural boundary.
